## Research Experience
My research examines sleep, circadian rhythms, and gut-brain interactions in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). I use patient-reported outcomes, wearable technology, clinical datasets, and prospective trials to identify modifiable contributors to symptom burden and treatment response.

Current projects evaluate medication administration timing, morning light therapy, and behavioral interventions to improve treatment response, sleep, and fatigue in IBD. These studies combine patient-reported outcomes with wearable measures of sleep and circadian rhythms.
